# LUMOS-Water v1.8 Preview — Superseded

This document records the v1.8 national Water planning preview. Water was promoted to a public domain in v1.9 with flow-aware posterior inference, locked validation, robustness analysis, paper exports, and a four-case evidence suite.

Current documentation:

- `WATER_INFERENCE.md`
- `WATER_PUBLIC_RELEASE.md`
- `MODEL_SPECIFICATION.md`

The v1.8 geometric flow and branch structures remain transparent proxies in v1.9; authoritative NLDI/NHDPlus navigation and user-supplied utility topology remain future adapters.
